pages.title: Deadfloor Factory
pages.creator: A Sole Proprietorship
pages.description: Deadfloor Factory combines production planning with defending a core from zombies. Route materials through conveyors, storage, and machines to supply your guns, then expand the factory and research upgrades. Pause to rearrange the production lines before testing them against the next attacks.

pages.title: Astro Kitty Rush
pages.creator: ExcDev
pages.description: Astro Kitty Rush has you switch a spacefaring cat between lanes to avoid asteroids. Collect coins and powerups while trying to survive longer and improve your score. Missions give you additional goals during the runs through space.

pages.title: Connect the Dots - Color Lines
pages.creator: EXEC TECH GAMES
pages.description: Connect the Dots - Color Lines asks you to join matching dots with drawn paths. Click and drag with the mouse, or use a finger, to create the connections. Work through the colored arrangements and complete each puzzle at your own pace.

pages.title: Pixel Flow
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pixel Flow challenges you to send colored kittens onto tracks that clear matching pixel points. Plan each route around the others, because paths cannot overlap or cross. Choose your moves carefully to remove the colored points and solve the level.

pages.title: Witch Craft Potion Sort
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Witch Craft Potion Sort asks you to separate colorful liquids into bottles containing a single color. Select a bottle to pour its potion into another and reorganize the mixed layers. Complete the sorting to lift the curse on each arrangement.

pages.title: Stickman Kombat 2D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Stickman Kombat 2D offers stick figure fights with regular attacks, special moves, and timed combinations. Move into range, block incoming hits, and use jumps to get behind an opponent. Play alone or share one keyboard with another player in the two player mode.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Neon
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Neon has you fire glowing bubbles into matching groups of three or more. Clear the formation before advancing rows push it to the bottom. Check the current and upcoming bubble colors to plan shots and make useful matches.

pages.title: Sprunki Garden
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Sprunki Garden fills matching puzzles with Sprunki characters. Swipe the pieces into groups of three matching characters to clear them from the garden. Continue through the level progression by finding combinations among the different faces.

pages.title: Geometry Vibes Monster
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Geometry Vibes Monster sends your spaceship past spikes, obstacles, and monsters with different attack patterns. Hold the mouse button or Space to climb, then release to descend. Survive as far as possible, or race with up to four players using separate controls.

pages.title: Real Car Parking Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Real Car Parking Simulator tests your driving through parking situations such as parallel spaces and tight garages. Guide the car into the required position while judging the room around it. Each challenge changes the approach needed to park successfully.

pages.title: Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts
pages.creator: Ropoto
pages.description: Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts asks you to sort colored nuts according to their destination boxes. Tap to select and organize them, building matches of three nuts of the required color. Work through each arrangement by planning which nuts to move next.

pages.title: Zombie Outbreak Survive
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Zombie Outbreak Survive places you in a city where fast zombies will keep chasing you. Run to find room, aim your weapon, and shoot before they catch up. Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to handle your shots.

pages.title: Sudoblock Daily
pages.creator: Denda Games
pages.description: Sudoblock Daily combines block placement with Sudoku style regions. Fit pieces into the field and complete horizontal rows, vertical columns, or nine square blocks to clear space and score. Keep room for incoming shapes and return for a new daily challenge.

pages.title: Rainbow Girls NYE Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Rainbow Girls NYE Fashion lets you prepare Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet for New Year's Eve. Help the four friends select clothing and put together their celebration looks. Click or tap through the fashion choices to style each girl for the evening.

pages.title: Funny Mad Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Funny Mad Racing sends bouncy cars across uneven, pixel styled roads. Keep your vehicle under control through the levels, collect coins, and unlock additional features. You can also challenge a friend, with one player using WASD and the other the arrow keys.

pages.title: Hill Climb Pixel Car
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Hill Climb Pixel Car pits vehicles against each other on rough tracks of dirt, sand, mud, and grass. Use the pedals to accelerate or slow down while balancing over obstacles and jumps. Build enough speed to overtake rivals and reach the finish ahead.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunt Racing
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Monster Truck Stunt Racing takes offroad competition through forest, desert, snowy, and nighttime courses. Balance on ramps, perform flips for extra points, and use bonuses such as nitro to get ahead. Spend earnings on vehicle upgrades and newly unlocked maps.

pages.title: Matchstick Puzzles
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Matchstick Puzzles asks you to correct equations and reshape geometric figures by changing their matches. Each task specifies how many sticks may be added, removed, or moved. Work out the arrangement that satisfies the puzzle while staying within those limits.

pages.title: Animals Merge
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Animals Merge uses numbered animal blocks in a merging puzzle. Choose a column to drop a block, then bring matching animals together to create one with a larger value. Keep combining them to discover the animals higher in the progression.

pages.title: Super Droid Adventure
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Super Droid Adventure follows a small robot seeking the boss who destroyed his castle. Jump through traps, defeat enemies, and break blocks to uncover coins and powerups. Use the robot's firepower to fight through the obstacles on the way to the final confrontation.

pages.title: They Are Coming
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: They Are Coming has you flee a crowd of red stick figures along platform courses. Slide sideways to collect guns and avoid obstacles while keeping the pursuers at a distance. At the finish, use a machine cannon to eliminate the enemies still chasing you.

pages.title: Bridge Water Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Bridge Water Rush turns swimming and bridge construction into a race. Gather purple wooden strips from the water and carry them to your lane, where they build the bridge automatically. Keep making trips and finish your crossing before the other competitors.

pages.title: Funny Rescue Sumo
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Rescue Sumo asks you to care for a wrestler after a rough match. Treat his wounds and help him recover from the fight, then give him a makeover. Use the mouse to carry out the care and styling activities.

pages.title: How many: Quiz game
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: How many: Quiz game tests your estimates with questions requiring numerical answers. Read each question and enter a number using the onscreen keyboard. Try to give the closest answer, because poor guesses leave your character facing sharks or dangerously hot water.

pages.title: Blondy Extra
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Blondy Extra lets you create outfits built around bright colors and bold accessories. Browse pieces such as printed denim, fluffy jackets, neon coats, and playful tops. Combine the clothes with shoes, jewelry, and other details to give Blondie an expressive look.

pages.title: Air Slip
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Air Slip puts a green ball on a rotating beam beneath falling colored cubes. Move the beam to catch green cubes with the ball and avoid purple ones. Green catches add points, while three contacts with purple cubes end the attempt.

pages.title: 9 Ball Pro
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: 9 Ball Pro offers pool matches against a computer opponent or a friend sharing your device. Hit the lowest numbered ball first with each shot, and keep the nine ball until last. Three computer difficulty settings let you choose the strength of the opponent.

pages.title: Minimal Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Minimal Bubble Shooter asks you to aim bubbles into clusters containing at least three of the same color. Click or touch where you want the shot to go and keep removing groups. Prevent any bubble from crossing the bottom line to stay in play.

pages.title: Homemade pastry Making
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Homemade pastry Making begins with shopping for the ingredients your recipe needs. Visit the grocery store, collect the required supplies, and return to prepare the pastry. Follow the cooking activities to turn those ingredients into a homemade treat.

pages.title: Sniper Trigger Revenge
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Sniper Trigger Revenge has you shoot escaped criminals across a series of missions. Plan ricochets and use objects in the scene to reach fugitives who are difficult to hit directly. Aim carefully so your shots do not harm the innocent people nearby.

pages.title: Idle Zoo
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Idle Zoo asks you to restore neglected zoos and turn their habitats into sources of income. Repair enclosures, improve the administrative building, and reinvest the earnings in your operation. Research additional animals to introduce as you move into later stages.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Deluxe offers an ongoing challenge of keeping colored bubbles away from the bottom line. Aim each shot at matching pieces to clear groups from the formation. Keep finding useful matches and see how long you can hold the bubbles back.

pages.title: Zombie Madness
pages.creator: Antpixel
pages.description: Zombie Madness casts you as a zombie trying to infect every human in the area. Guide the character with the arrow keys or touch controls and move into contact with the remaining people. Turn the entire group to complete the infection objective.

pages.title: Potion Flip
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Potion Flip challenges you to land a potion in a cauldron by flipping it through each level. Click or tap to send it onward and judge the next landing. Work through the Halloween puzzles and unlock additional potion designs.

pages.title: Castle Defense
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Castle Defense puts soldiers between your castle and waves of attacking monsters. Slide to change their formation and respond to the different enemies approaching the city. Adjust your defensive arrangement to exploit each monster's weakness and keep the castle protected.

pages.title: Fart Sheep
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description: Fart Sheep has you guide a sheep past obstacles using a single jumping action. Click to make it jump and judge the timing as the next hazard approaches. Keep clearing the obstacles to continue the run.

pages.title: Princess Baby Doll House Cleanup Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Princess Baby Doll House Cleanup Game asks you to prepare a neglected castle for its princess. Work through the rooms and carry out the cleaning tasks needed to improve them. Use the left mouse button to interact with the areas requiring attention.

pages.title: Sweet Party with Princesses
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Sweet Party with Princesses lets you dress princesses for a celebration in a land of candy. Pick outfits inspired by sweets and coordinate their looks with the sugary setting. Browse the fashion choices and prepare each princess for the themed party.

pages.title: Just Jump
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Just Jump asks you to keep jumping between blocks without falling. Judge the next landing and move onward to extend the attempt. The farther you progress across the blocks, the higher the score you can build.

pages.title: Lara and the skull gold
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Lara and the skull gold follows Lara on a quest to locate a missing puzzle piece. Explore the stages and collect artifacts along the way for bonus points. Use the arrow keys and Space on desktop, or the onscreen buttons on mobile.

pages.title: Cute Animals Pairs Game
pages.creator: GGMagenta
pages.description: Cute Animals Pairs Game hides animal pictures for you to match from memory. Click to reveal them and locate identical partners, remembering what earlier turns showed. Complete the five levels quickly to earn a higher score.

pages.title: F1 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: F1 Slide turns Formula One pictures into sliding tile puzzles. Move the pieces around the board until the selected racing image is reconstructed. Choose among three pictures and three modes to change the arrangement you want to solve.

pages.title: Girls and Cars Slide 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Girls and Cars Slide 2 offers sliding puzzles made from pictures of women and cars. Shift the tiles into place until each image is complete. Select one of three pictures and try the different modes to change the puzzle challenge.

pages.title: Santa Gift Delivery Truck
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Santa Gift Delivery Truck has you drive Santa's truck across snowy, uneven terrain while collecting presents. Keep the vehicle balanced on slippery roads and through changing weather. Gather as many gifts as possible for the children waiting for their deliveries.

pages.title: Christmas Bubbles
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Christmas Bubbles has you aim colored bubbles into matching groups of at least three. Click to fire and remove the connected colors from the formation. Continue making matches to increase your score in the holiday themed bubble challenge.

pages.title: Break The Snowman Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Break The Snowman Xmas asks you to move a snowman into the target snowmen to break them. Study the arrangement and choose your direction with the arrow keys. Find the movement sequence that clears the targets through the game's levels.

pages.title: Fruit Cut Master
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Fruit Cut Master challenges you to throw a knife through groups of fruit. Time each mouse controlled throw carefully to slice multiple targets and avoid missing them. Keep choosing the right moment as the fruit cutting challenges continue.

pages.title: Hyper Trigon Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Hyper Trigon Party has you rotate a colored triangle to match approaching lines. Tap to bring the correct side into position before contact. Collect triangles along the way to unlock alternative themes for the color matching challenge.

pages.title: Biggy Way
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Biggy Way sends a monster vehicle over rugged roads where balance and driving control matter. Collect money as you travel and use your earnings to buy additional cars. Take each vehicle onto the uneven courses and work through the driving challenges.

pages.title: BITCOIN vs ETHEREUM DASH IOTA
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: BITCOIN vs ETHEREUM DASH IOTA turns cryptocurrency icons into spinning competitors inside a ring. Press your button to send your coin forward and knock rivals over the edge while staying inside yourself. Face the computer or share the device with other players.

pages.title: Color Bump Online
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Color Bump Online asks you to guide a small colored box through an obstacle filled route. Touch objects matching your own color and avoid the differently colored hazards. Click or tap to control the box as it moves through the course.

pages.title: Super Doll Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Super Doll Skin Doctor puts you in charge of treating a superhero doll's skin problems. Use tools such as tweezers and lasers to work on rashes and other affected areas. Tap through the treatments to prepare her for another adventure.

pages.title: Kids True Color
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Kids True Color tests whether a pictured pencil matches the color name shown with it. Choose the correct or incorrect answer for each combination. Compare the word and the actual color carefully as you work through the questions.

pages.title: Fighting Planes
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Fighting Planes asks you to survive enemy aircraft while shooting them down. Move around incoming attacks and collect stars and powerups dropped in parachute crates. Keep fighting to extend the run and increase your score.

pages.title: Princess Nation Lovers
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Nation Lovers lets you style Emma, Mia, Bella, and Audrey in outfits inspired by national flags. Choose clothing and makeup for each princess to express her country's colors. Use the mouse to put together their themed fashion looks.

pages.title: Bosnia Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Bosnia Puzzle Challenge offers jigsaws built from pictures of Bosnia. Choose an image and an easy, medium, or hard version, then assemble its scattered pieces. There is no time limit, allowing you to work through each picture at your own pace.

pages.title: Amazing Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Amazing Spider Solitaire challenges you to remove every card from the columns and stock. Reorganize the tableau into complete sequences while planning around the available cards. Choose a one suit, two suit, or four suit game to set the difficulty.

pages.title: Feed The Frog
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Feed The Frog has you guide a frog to food such as ants, spiders, and fish. Collect the edible items while staying clear of the bombs appearing among them. A bomb hit ends the game, so watch what you approach.

pages.title: Knife Trials
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Knife Trials tests your timing as you throw knives toward rotating targets. Pick a moment to launch each blade and try to land accurate hits. Keep building your score through the endless sequence of throwing challenges.

pages.title: Elite Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Elite Racing offers races against computer drivers on four tracks. Choose from cars in the shop, change your vehicle's color, and try the different race modes. A replay feature lets you watch the action after testing your driving against the opposition.

pages.title: Kawaii Superhero Avatar Maker
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Kawaii Superhero Avatar Maker lets you design a superhero girl from a large selection of character items. Combine clothing and appearance choices into a classic comic inspired heroine or a modern design. Create an original character or imagine yourself as a superhero.

pages.title: Christmas Vehicles Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Christmas Vehicles Jigsaw combines holiday scenes with vehicles across twelve puzzle pictures. Choose an easy 25 piece, medium 49 piece, or hard 100 piece version. Fit the pieces together to rebuild the selected festive image.

pages.title: 2D Crazy Basketball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: 2D Crazy Basketball challenges you to throw basketballs into hoops and build your score. Judge the shot and send the ball toward the basket as the target positions change. Keep making baskets to improve your result.

pages.title: Events Fashion Advisor
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Events Fashion Advisor asks you to dress characters for occasions such as an office day, a business meeting, or a movie night. Browse the clothing and design a hairstyle to suit each event. Match the finished look to the situation being presented.

pages.title: Hidden Jingle Bells
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Hidden Jingle Bells asks you to search each picture for five concealed bells. Look closely at the scene and select the hidden objects as you find them. Discover all five to unlock the next holiday search.

pages.title: Nom Nom Yum
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Nom Nom Yum challenges you to feed sushi to a hungry monster by cutting its ropes. Watch the food swing, then swipe at the right moment to drop it into Nom Nom's mouth. Collect the three stars in a level for the best score.

pages.title: Your Stylish Summer Checklist
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Your Stylish Summer Checklist takes you shopping with Jasmin after she decides her wardrobe needs an update. Help her choose bright, colorful clothing and put together new summer outfits. Explore the fashion options to replace her old looks with fresh combinations.

pages.title: Puppet Soccer Challenge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Puppet Soccer Challenge puts a legless soccer character in a goal scoring contest. Send the ball into the net and keep adding to your total. Try to improve your best score through a succession of successful shots.

pages.title: Valentine Girl Jumping
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Valentine Girl Jumping has you jump through the air to gather Valentine items and diamonds. The themed pickups are worth two points each, while diamonds award five. Avoid the bombs, because three hits bring the attempt to an end.

pages.title: UFO Run. The castle tower
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: UFO Run. The castle tower sends a green alien through an old castle with a jetpack. Control the thrust to move between deadly spikes and collect stars along the corridors. Gain levels and achievements as you continue exploring the tower.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Halloweeny
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle: Halloweeny offers sixteen Halloween pictures to assemble from jigsaw pieces. Choose a scene and fit the fragments together until the full image returns. Work through the selection of spooky pictures one puzzle at a time.

pages.title: Kitty Dental Caring
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Kitty Dental Caring puts you in charge of helping a cat with painful dental problems. Use the available treatment tools to care for its mouth and teeth. After completing the dental work, move to the dressing stage and choose a new look.

pages.title: Summer Swimsuits Contest!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Summer Swimsuits Contest! lets you prepare Ellie, Annie, and Aria for a swimwear competition. Browse the available costumes and select a look for each character. Combine the fashion options to help your chosen princess stand out in the contest.

pages.title: Missile Outbreak
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Missile Outbreak asks you to defend your country against incoming missiles. Use the mouse or keyboard to respond to the attacks and destroy the threatening projectiles. Keep up with the targets as you work to protect the people below.

pages.title: Blocks
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Blocks challenges you to remove clusters of matching colored blocks while leaving as few pieces as possible. Click a group to clear it, with larger groups earning more points. Track the remaining block count and your score on the side of the board.

pages.title: Princess Doll House Decoration
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Doll House Decoration combines dressing a princess with redesigning her home. Select an outfit and accessories, then choose decorative styles for the bathroom and living room. Coordinate the rooms and the character's appearance using the available design choices.

pages.title: Ice Queen Souvenier Boutique
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Ice Queen Souvenier Boutique sends you searching a gift shop for hidden presents. Look through the boutique and find the requested gifts before the time allowance expires. Work quickly to complete the holiday shopping search.
